name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: Direct2D partial repaint pouziva dirty-rect clip v native batchi a GDI interop DC se inicializuje pres CLEAR misto zbytecneho COPY. Smoke hlida, ze partial material repaint nespusti full-scene text/bitmap paint.
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: Direct2D partial repaint uses a dirty-rect clip in the native batch and initializes the GDI interop DC with CLEAR instead of unnecessary COPY. The smoke test guards that a partial material repaint does not trigger full-scene text/bitmap paint.
